question: Four words are given, out of which three words are spelt correctly. Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Equipment.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given question, the word in option 3 is incorrectly spelt.**
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is "EQUIPMENT".**
 
• The incorrect option has an extra "T" after "QUIP"
 
 
• The word means "the necessary items for a particular purpose"(उपकरण)
 
• Example: The laboratory has all the necessary equipment for conducting experiments.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 - INOCULATE means "to vaccinate or immunize"(टीका लगाना)
 
• Option 2 - MEMENTO means "a souvenir or keepsake" (स्मृति चिन्ह)
 
• Option 4 - CEMETERY means "a burial ground" (कब्रिस्तान)
